title: Player 1's HUD in split screen: squeezed vs fitted (Split Screen 0.2.0-dev23)
intro: Two short looks at player 1's view, about 1 minute. Stay in split screen (3 across). Nothing to do but look; press End to go on.

steps.text: A. The game's own HUD: full size, but squeezed (oval minimap, narrow text). Look at player 1's view, then press End.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.fit_hud ~= false then S.cfg.fit_hud = false end

steps.text: B. Fitted: round and readable, along the bottom, but about a third of the size. Look, then press End.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.fit_hud ~= true then S.cfg.fit_hud = true end

steps.text: Tell Claude which you'd rather play with: A (big, squeezed) or B (small, round). B stays on for now. Press End.
steps.each_frame: local S=_G.DPC_SplitScreen; if S and S.cfg.fit_hud ~= true then S.cfg.fit_hud = true end
